findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getAccessibilityReport, getSessionScreenshots, getSessionVideo, tm_get_coverage_summary, tm_generate_test_cases, tm_update_test_run, smartui_comparison_query, smartui_comparison_analyze, downloadJobArtifact · Private data: deletePrerunFile, deleteUserFile, tm_generate_test_cases, tm_create_test_run, tm_record_test_results, smartui_screenshot_upload, downloadJobArtifact · Public sink: upload_app, generateHyperExecuteYAML, postSessionExceptions, postTestExceptions, uploadAppVirtualDevice, smartui_screenshot_upload · Destructive: getAccessibilityReport, buildLocalAppForAnalysis, triggerSuiteRun, getSuiteOverview, stopTunnel, deleteSession, deletePrerunFile, deleteUserFile, deleteUploadedApps, tm_list_folders, tm_list_configurations, tm_get_test_runs, tm_create_test_run, tm_update_test_run, tm_record_test_results, tm_link_jira_issue, tm_link_ado_issue, smartui_comparison_analyze.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getAccessibilityReport, getSessionScreenshots, getSessionVideo, tm_get_coverage_summary, tm_generate_test_cases, tm_update_test_run, smartui_comparison_query, smartui_comparison_analyze, downloadJobArtifact · Private data: deletePrerunFile, deleteUserFile, tm_generate_test_cases, tm_create_test_run, tm_record_test_results, smartui_screenshot_upload, downloadJobArtifact · Public sink: upload_app, generateHyperExecuteYAML, postSessionExceptions, postTestExceptions, uploadAppVirtualDevice, smartui_screenshot_upload · Destructive: getAccessibilityReport, buildLocalAppForAnalysis, triggerSuiteRun, getSuiteOverview, stopTunnel, deleteSession, deletePrerunFile, deleteUserFile, deleteUploadedApps, tm_list_folders, tm_list_configurations, tm_get_test_runs, tm_create_test_run, tm_update_test_run, tm_record_test_results, tm_link_jira_issue, tm_link_ado_issue, smartui_comparison_analyze

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
